dsh-write-gate is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Commitment write-gate: operator-authored rules enforced before a tool call runs — a deterministic guard tier plus an LLM-judge tier, fail-closed by default, every block written to a contradictions log.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9108f21a21644cd742e0.html
